issues.issue: Whether the RPD reasonably distinguished discrimination from persecution in its analysis
issues.applicant_position: RPD erred in its persecution versus discrimination analysis.
issues.respondent_position: Applicants' evidence was not ignored; insufficient to show the decision was unreasonable.
issues.result_text: RPD's conclusion that the harms were discrimination, not persecution, was open and reasonable.

issues.issue: Whether the RPD reasonably assessed state protection
issues.applicant_position: RPD erred in assessing state protection and overlooked contradictory supporting evidence.
issues.respondent_position: Applicants' evidence was not ignored; insufficient to show the decision was unreasonable.
issues.result_text: RPD's state protection reasoning was reasonable despite contradictory evidence; applicants made no real effort to use police.

issues.issue: Whether the RPD reasonably found an internal flight alternative in Debrecen
issues.applicant_position: RPD erred in considering the internal flight alternative.
issues.result_text: Nothing unreasonable in the RPD's conclusion that an internal flight alternative was available.
